purpose: Teach: 門真/三谷/上村/奥山/二宮/坂田/西岡/西山

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、門真に工場を建てられた
lines.en: When your father was young, he built a factory in Kadoma.
lines.style: Quiet, measured reflection. Gentle nostalgia in the phrasing — not mournful, but present. Slight pause before the place name, as if seeing it clearly in memory. Steady eye contact, the rhythm of someone recounting something significant without fanfare.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは三谷氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: Yes. Father established a joint venture with Mitani.
lines.style: Respectful, steady affirmation. Not performative — acknowledging both the memory and the partnership with equal weight. A composed tone that signals this is serious family history being honored. Slight emphasis on the partnership itself, not the action.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、上村先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: When your father was young, he learned under Kamimura—a true mentor to him.
lines.style: Soft, appreciative tone. The word 'mentor' carries warmth — this was formative, not transactional. Slight lift on the name, a private gratitude beneath the surface. Unhurried pace, almost tender in its remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは奥山氏と海外進出を企画された
lines.en: Yes. Father planned our overseas expansion with Okuyama.
lines.style: Calm, factual but not cold. The speaking slightly more deliberate — these are not small accomplishments. A son's quiet pride in his father's vision, delivered without emphasis. Steady, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、二宮氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: When your father was young, he made Ninomiya the foundation of our public relations.
lines.style: Voice carries the weight of strategic choice. Not casual — this was foresight. A gentle certainty in the phrasing. The kind of memory where you can see the person being chosen, the reasoning behind it. Quiet respect for the decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは坂田氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: Yes. Father built our accounting structure with Sakata.
lines.style: Composed, steady. The acknowledgment of foundational work — less visible than expansion but equally essential. A son confirming his father's thoroughness and foresight. Even pacing, grounded and sincere.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、西岡氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When your father was young, he founded our overseas corporation with Nishioka.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly more weight on this one — a significant milestone. The pacing allows each part to settle. A grandfather's recognition of his son's ambition and execution. Not quick or light — substantial and true.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは西山氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. Father entrusted all legal matters to Nishiyama.
lines.style: Final affirmation, slightly deeper and more resonant. The word 'entrusted' carries the full weight of delegation — not just assigned but trusted. A closing reflection, calm and conclusive. Pause slightly longer after the yes. The voice contains something complete.
